profile.headline: US Army Veteran | Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm Roberto Rodriguez, a dedicated Ruby on Rails Software Engineer with a passion for learning and creating secure and efficient applications. 

In my current role as a Ruby on Rails Software Engineer, I've had the privilege of working collaboratively with talented teams to integrate various APIs and authentication systems, such as Microsoft Auth. These integrations have allowed us to create seamless user experiences while prioritizing application security.

Here are some of my key technical skills:

Languages: Ruby, HTML5, CSS, SQL, APIs, JS
Frameworks/Libraries: Rails, ActiveRecord, jQuery, ActiveStorage
Tools/Other: PostgreSQL, Git, Heroku, Docker, CI

I'm always eager to learn and grow in my field, and I'm committed to delivering high-quality solutions that meet the needs of users and stakeholders alike.

I look forward to creating new connections.
